visualCharacteristics: Numbered steps side by side in a staggered row on desktop (icon above title and text, centered), stacked on mobile.
contentPattern: One row per step. Cell 1: icon image. Cell 2: H3 step title (e.g. '1o Passo: Faca a adesao ao seguro') + description paragraph.
usage: Seguro Protege Casa 'Contratacao simples e sem burocracia' three steps (adesao, pagamento na conta de luz, seguro ativo).
reuseGuidance: Use for short ordered processes (2-5 steps). Rendered as an ordered list. Place the section heading, logo and closing CTA as default content in the same section (section style: centered).
